components.css: .ds-showcase { background:var(--color-ink, #141420); padding:1.5rem; } .ds-foil { padding:2px; border-radius:16px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--color-accent, #c49350),var(--color-lavender, #cdd1ff) 24%,var(--color-indigo-2, #3b3b75) 50%,var(--color-lavender, #cdd1ff) 75%,var(--color-accent, #c49350)); box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / .25); } .ds-stage { position:relative; min-height:210px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:14px; background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 48% 40%,var(--color-indigo-2, #3b3b75),var(--color-ink, #141420) 72%); } .ds-stage::after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:-60%; background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 43%,rgb(205 209 255 / .04) 47%,rgb(255 255 255 / .14) 50%,rgb(196 147 80 / .06) 53%,transparent 57%); transform:translateX(-65%); pointer-events:none; } .ds-seal { position:absolute; bottom:1rem; left:1rem; z-index:3; padding:.65rem .85rem; background:var(--color-ink, #141420); border:1px solid var(--color-accent, #c49350); border-radius:3px; color:var(--color-paper, #f6f7ff); font-family:var(--font-body, "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif); font-size:.72rem; line-height:1.5; } @media(hover:hover) and (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference) { .ds-showcase:hover .ds-stage::after { animation:ds-foil-sweep 1100ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } } @keyframes ds-foil-sweep { to { transform:translateX(65%); } }

narrative.overview:
A direct local-service identity built from Crossbell’s existing crest, gold, lavender, and indigo. Condensed display type gives short statements presence; practical body type and generous separation keep the offer easy to scan for prospective host businesses.

The trading-card treatment extends that identity through dark surfaces, actual machine photography, and a restrained foil frame. It is a premium product expression within Crossbell, not a new brand. This document records the built system; no approved visual comp was supplied.
keyCharacteristics: Crest-derived color and locally bundled typography.
Strong condensed headings with plain, readable service copy.
Ruled lists and tonal sections rather than a page full of raised cards.
Actual installation and supplier imagery with clear captions.
Gold actions and visible keyboard focus on both light and dark surfaces.

rules.name: The Crest Continuity Rule
rules.body: Extend the existing gold, lavender, indigo, ink, and paper relationships when adding a surface. Supplier-photo mint backgrounds and example wraps belong to the photography, not the brand palette.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use condensed type for headings and body type for explanations and controls. Keep mono for utility information.

rules.name: The Motion Restraint Rule
rules.body: Keep foil as a hover response. Honor reduced motion: the built global override minimizes animation and transitions, disables smooth scrolling, and the machine image explicitly removes its transition.

dos: Do reuse the crest palette, existing fonts, shared shell, and gold primary actions.
Do use real photography and identify supplier examples clearly.
Do preserve contained hardware images, visible focus, native disclosures, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use the dark trading-card treatment as an extension of Crossbell’s identity.
donts: Don't replace the brand palette with mint or colors embedded in supplier wraps.
Don't turn the foil treatment into continuous ambient animation.
Don't spread the showcase’s large rounded frame and shadow across ordinary ruled content.
Don't imply that supplier example photography documents a Crossbell installation.
